native_links.scope:
Owned-screen link input regression; production engine/network are Rust.
Start one release olo-browser on a 1280x800 Agent Screen initially at 2x,
eval its environment, then: THIS_SCRIPT NAME /var/tmp/OWNED/output.
Add --inline for inline spacing; --breaks for semantic br/wbr and carrier-free text.
No website journey acceptance follows from these authored fixtures.

navigation.scope:
Native navigation on an OWN Agent Screen; authored fixtures accept no sites.
Start release olo-browser there, eval olo-screen env, then run NAME OUTPUT_DIR.
Checks canonical redirects, in-document identity/no I/O, history, keyboard focus
and scroll restoration at all native modes/scales. HTTP server is test-only.

baseline_build.method: Git archive of crates/web and Cargo.lock into an owned disk directory; standalone manifest retaining original workspace dependency/profile settings. Separate target from current source; build default release page_bench and scene_bench, freeze before measurements. Native before binary frozen directly from default 3035b3ff workspace build.
baseline_build.manifest:
[workspace]
members=["crates/web"]
resolver="3"
[workspace.package]
version='0.1.0'
edition='2024'
license='MIT'
[workspace.dependencies]
serde_json='1'
[profile.release]
debug="line-tables-only"

native_sampler_fix: Require no existing Browser on the owned screen, assert launched PID owns exactly one mapped window, invoke quit and wait for process exit with pidfd before another frozen launch. A forwarded-PID native attempt failed before any sample was accepted.

native_cost.scope: Frozen3035b3ff before and optimized merged350f22c6 after, common merged server, default wheel speed1. No builds during this sample. Actual launched PID checked, each process quit and awaited before next launch. Authored text, client submission latency only; not image workload, compositor presentation, maximum latency or general browser memory.
